jobs.title: Finance Manager
jobs.description:
About Pave Bank



Pave Bank is a fully licensed commercial bank, regulated by the National Bank of Georgia. We are reimagining how global businesses access and move capital by bridging the gap between traditional finance and digital assets. Joining Pave Bank means becoming part of a fast-growing institution redefining this convergence. You will have the opportunity to work alongside second-time founders and industry leaders, gain deep exposure to institutional banking and digital assets, and grow within a dynamic and ambitious team.


The Role

We are seeking a Financial Controller/Senior Accounting Manager to join our team. The position will be based in Malaysia (or SEA) with travel to Georgia. This role will be part of the Finance Function reporting to the VP, Finance with a mandate to own, build, and scale the bank’s accounting infrastructure and core ledger. The role will take end-to-end ownership of maintaining financial controls and reporting, using industry-leading tools and technology to build processes that scale with the bank.


Key Responsibilities

 - Accounting & Financial Reporting: Own the monthly, quarterly, and annual financial close across Group entities, including bookkeeping, reconciliations, intercompany accounting, consolidation, and preparation of financial statements.

 - Finance Operations: Manage day-to-day finance operations, including client invoicing, collections, accounts payable, vendor bills, and payment processing across the Group.

 - Audit: Own and coordinate Group and entity-level audits, including preparation of supporting schedules, management of auditor requests, and resolution of audit findings.

 - Financial Controls: Develop and maintain robust financial controls, accounting policies, approval processes, and documented finance procedures across the Group.

 - Statutory & Regulatory Reporting: Support the preparation and submission of statutory accounts, regulatory financial reporting, and other finance-related filings across Group entities.

 - Finance Process Improvement: Identify opportunities to improve and automate accounting, reconciliation, reporting, and other finance workflows as the business scales.

 

Requirements

 - The ideal candidate has 6–12 years of experience in accounting, financial reporting, or finance operations, with experience managing month-end close, reconciliations, and financial statements across multiple entities.

 - Experience working at a Big 4 accounting firm, particularly in audit or accounting advisory, is strongly preferred; experience in a startup, digital asset services, fintech, or regulated financial services environment is a plus.

 - Strong knowledge of IFRS accounting standards, with the ability to assess and apply appropriate accounting treatment to complex transactions.

 - Strong understanding of financial statements, consolidation, and intercompany accounting, with experience across multi-entity or international group structures preferred.

 - Experience supporting or managing external audits, statutory reporting, financial controls, and accounting policies.

 - Proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets and enterprise-grade accounting/ERP systems; familiarity with leveraging AI and automation tools to improve finance processes is a plus.

jobs.title: People Operations Manager
jobs.description:
About Pave Bank

Pave Bank is a fully licensed commercial bank, regulated by the National Bank of Georgia. We are reimagining how global businesses access and move capital by bridging the gap between traditional finance and digital assets. Joining Pave Bank means becoming part of a fast-growing institution redefining this convergence. You will have the opportunity to work alongside second-time founders and industry leaders, gain deep exposure to institutional banking and digital assets, and grow within a dynamic and ambitious team.



The Role

We are seeking a People Operations Manager to join our team. The position will be based in Malaysia (or SEA) with travel to Georgia. This role will be responsible for building, owning, and scaling the people operations infrastructure across Pave Bank as we grow across multiple countries and entities. The role will have end-to-end ownership of core HR processes, systems, policies, and employee administration, while partnering closely with leadership and managers to create a consistent and high-quality employee experience across the Group.

The ideal candidate will be highly hands-on, comfortable operating in a fast-growing environment, and able to build scalable processes rather than simply administer existing ones.


Key Responsibilities

 - People Operations: Own day-to-day people operations across the employee lifecycle, including onboarding, employee changes, documentation, leave administration, benefits, and offboarding across Group entities.

 - HRIS & People Systems: Own and continuously improve the Group’s HRIS and people technology stack, ensuring employee data is accurate, processes are automated where possible, and systems can support a multi-entity and multi-country organization.

 - Payroll & Benefits: Coordinate payroll and benefits administration across jurisdictions, working with Finance, external payroll providers, and local partners to ensure accurate and timely processing.

 - Process Improvement: Continuously identify opportunities to simplify, automate, and improve people processes while maintaining appropriate controls and documentation.

 - Entity & Corporate Administration: Coordinate entity-level corporate administration and liaise with corporate secretarial providers across Group entities to maintain accurate corporate records, support required filings and governance processes, and provide entity documentation internally as needed.



Requirements

 - The ideal candidate has 6–10 years of experience in People Operations, HR Operations, or generalist HR roles, with meaningful ownership and hands-on experience of core HR processes rather than purely advisory experience.

 - Demonstrated experience building or significantly improving HR processes and systems, ideally within a startup, scale-up, fintech, financial services, or similarly fast-moving organization.

 - Experience supporting a multi-country and multi-entity workforce, with an understanding of the operational complexities of employment across different jurisdictions.

 - Strong experience with HRIS platforms, payroll administration, employee data management, and HR process automation.

 - Experience managing onboarding, offboarding, employment documentation, policies, and employee relations.

 - Comfortable working independently with a high degree of ownership, including identifying gaps and implementing solutions without requiring highly developed existing processes.
